title: Notice to students of the 3rd , 5th, 7th and 9th Semesters to submit an undertaking

source.name: Chanakya National Law University, Patna, Bihar

text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
Chanakya National Law University
Nyaya Nagar, Mithapur,
Patna – 800001
Date: 23rd September 2026.
NOTICE
It is hereby notified that the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor has permitted all the students of 3rd, 5th,
7th and 9th Semester of the 5 Year B.A./B.B.A. LL.B. programme who have a shortage of
attendance below 67 per cent to appear in the End-Semester Examination, September 2026,
subject to the condition, that the student shall submit an undertaking stating that not only he/she
shall fulfil the mandatory 75% attendance criteria in the next semester but also compensate the
loss of attendance by which he/she was falling short of attendance in the ongoing odd semester.
Concerned students are required to submit the undertaking to the email id
attendance@cnlu.ac.in .
By Order
Sd/-
Prof. (Dr.) S. P. Singh
Registrar
Chanakya National Law University, Patna.
